title: Topic 20
japanese_text: 最近、一日中気分が落ち込んでいて、食欲<u>不振</u>などの症状もあったため、病院で相談したところ、<u>うつ病</u>と診断された。<u>息を抜く</u>暇もなく働いていたことによるストレスが原因だったようだ。現在は<u>休職し</u>、<u>カウンセリング</u>を受けながら自分を<u>労わる</u>ようにしていて、徐々に良くなってきている。
english_translation: Recently, I was feeling depressed all day long and had symptoms such as loss of appetite, so I went to the hospital and was diagnosed with depression. Apparently it was caused by stress from working without taking time to catch my breath. At the moment, I'm taking a leave of absence, receiving counseling, and taking care of myself, and I'm gradually getting better.

annotated_words.meaning_en: absence from work, take a leave of absence
